zh: 週日休市，週一開盤前先記住上週五的收盤：道瓊下跌 652.82 點（-1.23%）收 52,215.16，標普 500 下跌 0.52% 至 7,623.68，那斯達克下跌 0.21% 至 25,955.34，羅素 2000 下跌 0.29% 至 2,775.90。這是一週壓軸的賣壓，主因是原油大漲與十年期殖利率貼近 5%。標普 500 今年累計仍約上漲 12%，這波多頭剛滿四週年。
en: Markets are closed on Sunday, so here is Friday's close to carry into Monday: the Dow fell 652.82 points (-1.23%) to 52,215.16, the S&P 500 lost 0.52% to 7,623.68, the Nasdaq slipped 0.21% to 25,955.34 and the Russell 2000 dropped 0.29% to 2,775.90. Surging crude and a 10-year yield near 5% weighed on stocks. The S&P 500 is still up about 12% this year, and the bull market just marked its fourth anniversary.

道瓊 ETF，指數 -1.23%
那斯達克 100 ETF，綜合指數 -0.21%

zh: 週五的主線是能源與利率：WTI 上漲 3.97 美元（+3.99%）至 103.44 美元，布蘭特結算 116.72 美元，為 5 月以來高點，報導把原因指向市場擔心美國對伊朗再度升級軍事行動。十年期美債殖利率上升約 3.5 個基點至 4.988%，黃金下跌 1.24% 至約 4,010 美元。油價推升通膨預期、殖利率壓住估值，是本週要一起看的兩個數字；原因是各家報導的推測，無法由價格確認。
en: Energy and rates led Friday: WTI rose $3.97 (+3.99%) to $103.44 and Brent settled at $116.72, the highest since May, with reports pointing to fears of renewed US military escalation against Iran. The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 3.5 bps to 4.988% and gold fell 1.24% to about $4,010. Oil lifts inflation expectations while yields cap valuations. The cause is the reporters' inference and cannot be confirmed from prices.

zh: 把週四與週五放在一起看：週四那斯達克出現 6 月以來最大的單日跌幅，Meta 與科林研發（Lam Research）的財報讓 AI 股重摔；週五反過來，道瓊重挫、那斯達克僅小跌。兩天的共同點是成本——一天是 AI 資本支出，一天是油價與殖利率。這種輪流下跌的結構，代表市場同時在質疑兩件事，不是單一題材出清。
en: Put Thursday and Friday together: Thursday was the Nasdaq's biggest one-day drop since June, driven by disappointing Meta and Lam Research results; Friday flipped, with the Dow down sharply and the Nasdaq only slightly lower. The common thread is cost: AI capex one day, oil and yields the next. Rotating selloffs suggest the market is questioning two things at once rather than purging a single theme.

那斯達克 100 ETF，週四領跌

zh: 美國運通第三季調整後每股盈餘 4.68 美元，優於市場預期，但營收 200.6 億美元低於預估，同時宣布裁減約 5% 員工，股價週五跌約 3%。獲利優於預期、營收不及，加上裁員，市場讀到的是成本控制與需求之間的拉扯，而不是單純的好消息。下一個要看的是支出成長能否在高利率環境下維持。
en: American Express reported third-quarter adjusted EPS of $4.68, ahead of expectations, but revenue of $20.06 billion missed estimates, and it announced a cut of about 5% of staff. The stock fell about 3% Friday. A beat on earnings, a miss on revenue and layoffs read as a tug-of-war between cost control and demand. The next thing to watch is whether card spending growth holds up with rates this high.

stocks.n: 美國運通，裁員約 5%、營收不及，股價約 -3%
Capital One，信用卡同業對照
Visa，支付網路同業對照

zh: 本週最大的財報衝擊是 Meta：公司把 2026 年資本支出下限拉到 1,350 億美元，股價單日重摔約 7%，隔天再跌約 1%。Lam Research 的財報同樣讓投資人失望，兩者一起把週四的那斯達克拖到 6 月以來最大跌幅。教訓不在單一公司，而在市場開始要求 AI 支出要有看得見的回報，這個標準將在下週微軟、Alphabet、亞馬遜身上再測一次。
en: The biggest earnings shock of the week was Meta: it lifted its 2026 capital expenditure floor to $135 billion, the stock dropped about 7% in one session and slipped another 1% the next day. Lam Research also disappointed, and together they dragged the Nasdaq to its biggest one-day fall since June. The lesson is less about one company than about the market demanding visible returns on AI spending, a test that Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon face next week.

stocks.n: Meta，資本支出下限 1,350 億美元，股價約 -7%
Lam Research，財報令人失望
輝達，AI 資本支出鏈的指標

zh: 聯準會 10 月 28 日（週三）公布決策，利率目前在 3.75% 至 4.00%，9 月才剛升息。利率期貨顯示本次再升息的機率約 5%，12 月升息的機率約 80%（各家定價不一）。華許（Kevin Warsh）主席的記者會是焦點，威廉斯等官員已表態不傾向連續升息，節奏約每季一次。決策日離 11 月 3 日期中選舉不到一週，是另一個變數。
en: The Fed announces its decision Wednesday, Oct. 28, with rates at 3.75% to 4.00% after a September hike. Futures imply about a 5% chance of another hike this week and roughly an 80% chance in December, though pricing varies by source. Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference is the focus; Williams and others have pushed back on back-to-back hikes, suggesting about one per quarter. The meeting falls less than a week before the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

stocks.n: 長天期美債 ETF，對利率路徑最敏感
美元指數 ETF，鷹派持平的受惠方向
短天期美債 ETF，反映 12 月升息定價

zh: 不只聯準會：加拿大央行週三被預期升息 25 個基點（機率約 80%，但 9 月失業率升到 6.5%、CPI 低於預期）；紐西蘭央行週三升息也幾乎被完全定價，不過第三季 CPI 從 4.1% 降到 3.7%，指引有偏鴿風險。歐洲央行週四預期按兵不動，焦點是拉加德對 12 月的暗示；日本央行週五預期維持，12 月升息在討論範圍內。多國同時在升息邊緣，是這一週美元與債市的共同背景。
en: It is not only the Fed: the Bank of Canada is expected to hike 25 bps on Wednesday (about 80% odds, despite unemployment rising to 6.5% and a soft CPI), and a Reserve Bank of New Zealand hike is nearly fully priced, though Q3 CPI eased from 4.1% to 3.7%, leaving dovish-guidance risk. The ECB is expected to hold Thursday with focus on Lagarde's December hints, and the Bank of Japan is expected to hold Friday with a December hike on the table. Several central banks sitting at the edge of hikes is the shared backdrop for the dollar and bonds.

stocks.n: 歐元 ETF，歐洲央行週四決策
日圓 ETF，日本央行週五記者會
加幣 ETF，加拿大央行週三決策

zh: 週四（10/29）同時公布第三季 GDP 初值與 9 月 PCE：核心 PCE 預期年增 3.1%，GDP 預期年增 3.2%（年化）；另有報導把整體通膨預期放在 3.6% 到 3.7%，不同來源口徑不同。這兩份數據在聯準會決策後一天公布，若通膨高於預期，等於替 12 月升息加碼。同週還有 2、5、7 年期公債標售，需求偏弱會直接推升殖利率。
en: Thursday (Oct. 29) brings advance Q3 GDP and September PCE together: core PCE is expected up 3.1% year on year and GDP up 3.2% annualized, while another outlet puts headline inflation at 3.6% to 3.7%, so sources differ on the measure. Arriving a day after the Fed decision, a hot print would add weight to a December hike. The week also includes 2-, 5- and 7-year Treasury auctions, where weak demand would push yields higher.

stocks.n: 抗通膨債券 ETF，通膨數據的直接對照

en: Cybersecurity stocks rose against a weak tape on Friday: SailPoint, Cloudflare and Palo Alto Networks each gained more than 7%, with Yahoo Finance citing an Evercore ISI survey pointing to stronger enterprise security budgets. The signal is a brokerage survey rather than company results, so the one-day reaction may be exaggerated and needs confirmation from upcoming earnings and guidance.

zh: 布蘭特站上 116.72 美元的同時，航空股明顯走弱：聯合、達美、美國航空因燃油成本上升下跌；能源類股則是這波行情的直接受惠板塊。油價對板塊的影響是同一個數字的兩面，下週艾克森美孚與雪佛龍財報，會是檢驗能源獲利是否真的跟上油價的時刻。
en: With Brent at $116.72, airlines weakened sharply: United, Delta and American fell on higher fuel costs, while energy stocks were the direct beneficiaries. The oil move is two sides of one number. Exxon and Chevron report next week, which will show whether energy earnings are really keeping pace with crude.

zh: 羅素 2000 週四上漲 0.11% 至 2,784.03，週五下跌 0.29% 至 2,775.90，兩天累計約 -0.18%，同期那斯達克與道瓊各自經歷更大的單日跌幅。小型股沒有直接暴露在 AI 資本支出的疑慮裡，但對利率與融資成本更敏感，所以週五殖利率貼近 5% 時一樣受壓。
en: The Russell 2000 rose 0.11% to 2,784.03 on Thursday and fell 0.29% to 2,775.90 on Friday, about -0.18% over two days, while the Nasdaq and Dow each suffered larger single-day drops. Small caps are less exposed to AI-capex doubts but more sensitive to rates and financing costs, so they still slipped when yields neared 5%.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，兩日約 -0.18%
標普小型 600 ETF，品質較高的小型股對照
那斯達克 100 ETF，大型成長股對照

zh: 小型股對利率更敏感有兩個結構原因：第一，羅素 2000 成分公司負債中浮動利率比重較高，十年期殖利率貼近 5% 時，利息費用會更快侵蝕獲利；第二，小型股中銀行占比大，淨息差、存款成本與商用不動產風險都會被放大檢視。所以聯準會 12 月是否再升息，對小型股的影響通常比對大型股直接。這是判讀框架，不是預測。
en: Small caps are more rate-sensitive for two structural reasons: first, Russell 2000 companies carry more floating-rate debt, so a 10-year yield near 5% eats into earnings faster; second, banks make up a large share of the index, putting net interest margins, deposit costs and commercial real estate risk under the microscope. A December Fed hike therefore tends to matter more directly for small caps. This is an interpretive framework, not a forecast.

zh: 這家公司做什麼：加州北灣（Marin County）的社區銀行，服務當地中小企業與屋主。為什麼被忽視：市值不到 5 億美元，幾乎沒有大型券商追蹤，只在「便宜小型銀行」篩選裡偶爾出現。什麼正在改變：9 月內部人 Gary Strong 買進 2,000 股、約 6.5 萬美元，個人持股一口氣增加 16%；公司已確認 10/26（週一）召開第三季電話會議。風險：單一內部人買進的統計意義有限，加州商用不動產曝險要逐筆檢查，升息定價反轉也會壓淨息差。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: a community bank in Marin County, north of San Francisco, serving local small businesses and homeowners. Why it is overlooked: market cap under $500 million with almost no major broker coverage. What is changing: in September insider Gary Strong bought 2,000 shares (about $65,000), raising his holding 16%; the company has confirmed its Q3 call for Monday, Oct. 26. Risks: one insider buy has limited statistical weight, California commercial real estate exposure needs line-by-line checking, and rate repricing can squeeze margins. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

Risk: a $200 million shelf registration filed in September could mean an equity raise, the opposite signal to buybacks. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

Reports can be filed up to 45 days late, so prices have usually moved already. Treat this as a thematic clue, not a trading signal, and not as a suggestion of wrongdoing.

zh: FinWire 稱下週是本季最忙的一週，約三分之一的標普 500 公司公布。10/28（週三）預計：微軟（MSFT）、Alphabet（GOOGL）、T-Mobile、ServiceNow，與 FOMC 同日。10/29（週四）預計：亞馬遜（AMZN）、禮來（LLY）、英特爾（INTC）。同週還有 Sandisk、艾克森美孚、雪佛龍與開拓重工（CAT）。今年超大規模雲端業者的資本支出預期約 8,000 億美元；具體日期以公司公告為準。
en: FinWire calls next week the busiest of the season, with about a third of S&P 500 companies reporting. Expected Wednesday 10/28: Microsoft, Alphabet, T-Mobile and ServiceNow, the same day as the Fed. Expected Thursday 10/29: Amazon, Eli Lilly and Intel. Sandisk, Exxon, Chevron and Caterpillar also report that week. Hyperscaler capex is expected around $800 billion this year; confirm dates with company announcements.

zh: 把這週放在一起：Meta 把 2026 資本支出下限拉到 1,350 億美元、布蘭特 116.72 美元、十年期殖利率 4.99%、聯準會在 9 月升息後 12 月可能再升，另有多家央行在升息邊緣。AI 投資、能源、融資三種成本同時上升，市場在週四用那斯達克、週五用道瓊表現出來。下週微軟與 Alphabet 要在聯準會決策日當天交資本支出答案，這是本週最值得盯的事。這是資訊整理，不是買賣訊號。
en: Putting the week together: Meta lifted its 2026 capex floor to $135 billion, Brent hit $116.72, the 10-year yield reached 4.99%, the Fed may hike again in December after September, and several other central banks sit at the edge of hikes. AI, energy and financing costs are all rising at once, showing up in the Nasdaq on Thursday and the Dow on Friday. Microsoft and Alphabet must answer the capex question on the same day as the Fed decision, which is the one thing to watch. This is information, not a trading signal.
